title: American Realty Investors, Inc. Reports Earnings for Quarter Ended September 30, 2026
summary: DALLAS, November 12, 2026--American Realty Investors, Inc. (NYSE:ARL) is reporting its results of operations for the three months ended September 30, 2026. For the three months ended September 30, 2026, we reported net loss attributable to common shares of $0.7 million or $0.04 per share, compared to a net income attributable to common shares of $0.1 million or $0.01 per share for the same period in 2025.

title: ARL: Q3 Earnings Snapshot
summary: DALLAS (AP) — DALLAS (AP) — American Realty Investors Inc. (ARL) on Thursday reported a third-quarter loss of $702,000, after reporting a profit in the same period a year earlier.

title: American Realty Investors, Inc. reports Earnings for Quarter Ended June 30, 2026
summary: DALLAS, August 06, 2026--American Realty Investors, Inc. (NYSE:ARL) is reporting its results of operations for the three months ended June 30, 2026. For the three months ended June 30, 2026, we reported net loss attributable to common shares of $1.0 million or $0.06 per share, compared to a net income attributable to common shares of $2.8 million or $0.18 per share for the same period in 2025.
